notes.title: v1.2.3: Stability Update
notes.notes:
I had to strip gamepad support for macOS 10.15 and higher due to inexplicable crashes. Gamepads will still work on OS versions below 10.15.

I also updated the online/network menu to make it a little more clear what's expected and which IP addresses are which. You can now override your local/private IP address in rare cases where the underlying logic picked up the wrong one. 90% of the time you shouldn't need to change it, though.

notes.title: v1.1: Performance and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Upgraded game engine to improve performance and compatibility
 Fixed bug with online sound effects
 Fixed bug with online controller input
 Added mousewheel support for changing block type
